findings.reason: The evidence confirms transient, self-clearing alarms and zero service impact, but does not establish a causal link between the alarms and the metrics.
The cited evidence explicitly lists 20 alarms (8 TEMP_HIGH, 12 VSWR_HIGH) on S-SUD-007 within the specified time window, all self-clearing.
T4 shows availability at 100% and states that drop rate and download volume metrics showed no sustained deviation from baseline.
T5 and T7 explicitly report no maintenance windows or configuration changes on S-SUD-007 and its parents during the incident window.
